text: Euskaraz «berrogeita hamar» esaten dugunean, zer zenbaki da?
gloss: When we say "berrogeita hamar" in Basque, what number is it? — 50: berrogei (2×20 = 40) plus hamar (10); 30, 70 and 90 are hogeita hamar, hirurogeita hamar, laurogeita hamar.

text: Erlojuak «hamarrak laurden gutxi» markatzen ditu. Zer ordu da?
gloss: The clock shows "ten, a quarter less". What time is it? — 9:45: "laurden gutxi" is a quarter to the named hour.

text: Nolakoa da «mendizale» bat?
gloss: What is a "mendizale"? — Someone who loves the mountains: the suffix -zale means "fond of".

text: «Itsasargi» hitza «itsaso» eta «argi» hitzekin osatua dago. Zer da?
gloss: "Itsasargi" is built from "itsaso" (sea) and "argi" (light). What is it? — A lighthouse.

text: «Hamaika aldiz esan dizut!» dioenak, zenbat aldiz esan du?
gloss: Someone who says "I have told you eleven times!" — how many times did they say it? — Many times: "hamaika" (eleven) also means "a great many".

text: Sagardotegian «txotx!» oihukatzen denean, zer egin ohi da?
gloss: In a cider house, when someone shouts "txotx!", what do people do? — Go to the barrel to catch cider from the tap.

text: Herri-kiroletan, zer egiten du aizkolari batek?
gloss: In Basque rural sports, what does an aizkolari do? — Chops logs with an axe (the stone lifter is a harri-jasotzaile).

text: Iruñeko sanferminak txupinazoarekin hasten dira. Zein egunetan?
gloss: Pamplona's San Fermín starts with the chupinazo. On which day? — 6 July at noon; the 7th is San Fermín's own day.

text: Zein ibaik zeharkatzen du Bilbo, itsasoraino?
gloss: Which river crosses Bilbao down to the sea? — The Nervión (its estuary, the ría); the Urumea is Donostia's river.

text: Txalaparta tradizionalean, zer kolpatzen da makilekin?
gloss: In the traditional txalaparta, what is struck with sticks? — Wooden planks.

text: Bertsolari Txapelketa Nagusiko irabazleari zer jartzen zaio buruan?
gloss: What is placed on the head of the winner of the national bertsolari championship? — The txapela (beret), hence "txapeldun" (champion).

text: Euskal mitologiako Tartalo erraldoiak zer du berezia?
gloss: What is special about the giant Tartalo of Basque mythology? — He has a single eye (the Basque cyclops); seven heads belong to Herensuge.

text: Eduardo Txillidaren «Haizearen orrazia» itsasoaren aurrean dago. Zein hiritan?
gloss: Chillida's "Comb of the Wind" stands facing the sea. In which city? — Donostia/San Sebastián, at the end of Ondarreta beach.

text: Zergatik botatzen da gatza errepideetan neguan?
gloss: Why is salt spread on roads in winter? — It helps melt ice: salt water freezes below 0 °C.

text: Zergatik ez da metalezko ontzirik sartu behar mikrouhin-labean?
gloss: Why should no metal container go into a microwave oven? — It can make sparks (arcing).

text: Espresso bati ur bero gehiago gehitzen badiozu, zer kafe lortzen duzu?
gloss: If you add more hot water to an espresso, what coffee do you get? — An americano; the others add milk.

text: Frantziako Tourrean, zer koloretako maillota darama sailkapen nagusiko liderrak?
gloss: In the Tour de France, what colour jersey does the overall leader wear? — Yellow; pink is the Giro's, red the Vuelta's, green the Tour's points jersey.

text: Zein hiriburu dago ekuatoretik hurbilen?
gloss: Which capital lies closest to the equator? — Quito, about 25 km south of it; Ecuador takes its name from the line.

text: Zergatik ez zaie txokolaterik eman behar txakurrei?
gloss: Why should dogs not be given chocolate? — It is poisonous to them (theobromine).

text: Arropa-etiketan, ur-ontzi baten barruan esku bat ageri da. Zer esan nahi du?
gloss: On a clothing label, a hand appears inside a tub of water. What does it mean? — Hand wash only.

text: Europan, zein da larrialdi guztietarako telefono-zenbaki bakarra?
gloss: In Europe, what is the single phone number for all emergencies? — 112; 911 is North America's.

text: Zein bideojokotan erortzen dira forma desberdineko piezak, lerro osoak osatu eta ezabatzeko?
gloss: In which video game do pieces of different shapes fall, to complete and clear whole lines? — Tetris.

text: «Toy Story»n, zer da Woody panpina?
gloss: In "Toy Story", what is the Woody doll? — A cowboy; Buzz is the astronaut.

text: Zein aplikaziok ezagutzen du entzuten ari zaren abestia, mugikorra hurbilduta?
gloss: Which app recognises the song you are hearing when you hold up your phone? — Shazam.

text: Zertarako balio du bi urratseko egiaztapenak?
options: Pasahitzaz gain beste kode bat eskatzeko
gloss: What is two-step verification for? — To ask for a second code on top of the password.

text: Mendi gainera igotzean, patata frijituen poltsa itxia puztu egiten da. Zergatik?
gloss: Taken up a mountain, a sealed crisp bag puffs up. Why? — The outside air pressure is lower, so the air inside expands.

text: Zer da «spam»-a posta elektronikoan?
gloss: What is "spam" in e-mail? — Unsolicited mass messages.

text: Zein da Arrasateko kooperatibaren etxetresna-marka, garbigailuengatik ezaguna?
gloss: Which is the household-appliance brand of the Arrasate (Mondragón) cooperative, known for its washing machines? — Fagor; Balay is Aragonese, Teka German-Spanish, Bosch German.

text: Kiwia fruitua da, baina baita Zeelanda Berriko ikurra ere. Zer da ikur hori?
gloss: The kiwi is a fruit, but also New Zealand's emblem. What is that emblem? — A flightless bird.

text: Robinson Crusoek astegun baten izena jarri zion uharteko bere lagunari. Zein?
gloss: Robinson Crusoe named his island companion after a weekday. Which? — Friday (Ostirala), the day he met him.

text: Zer lekaleren gainean egiten da hummusa?
gloss: Which pulse is hummus made from? — Chickpeas.

text: «Euskaldun» hitza «euskara» eta «-dun» atzizkiaz osatua dago. Zer da, jatorriz, euskalduna?
gloss: "Euskaldun" is euskara + the suffix -dun. What is a euskaldun, by origin? — One who has (speaks) Basque: -dun means "having".

text: Zer zuhaitz mota da Gernikako Arbola?
gloss: What kind of tree is the Tree of Gernika? — An oak.

text: Athletic Clubek, bere filosofiaren arabera, zer jokalari hartzen ditu taldean?
gloss: Under its philosophy, which players does Athletic Club field? — Those born or trained in the Basque Country.

text: Zein odol-talde da emaile unibertsala, edonori eman dakiokeena?
gloss: Which blood group is the universal donor? — O negative (AB positive is the universal recipient).

text: Webgune baten helbidean, zer adierazten du «https»-ko azken «s» horrek?
gloss: In a web address, what does the final "s" of "https" indicate? — The connection is encrypted (secure).

text: Tenisean, 40-0 irabazten ari bazara, zenbat puntu behar dituzu gutxienez jokoa irabazteko?
gloss: In tennis, leading 40-0, how many points do you need at least to win the game? — One: 40 means three points won, and the next wins.

text: Zein artistak egin zituen Campbell's zopa-poteen serigrafia ospetsuak?
gloss: Which artist made the famous Campbell's soup can prints? — Andy Warhol.

text: Zein taldek abestu zuen «Lau teilatu»?
gloss: Which group sang "Lau teilatu"? — Itoiz (1987).

text: «Parkean umeak jolasten dira». Zenbat ume ari dira jolasean?
gloss: "In the park the children are playing" — how many children? — More than one: "umeak" alone could be singular ergative, but the plural verb "dira" makes it plural absolutive.

text: Zein hiriburu dago Danubio ibaiaren ertzean?
gloss: Which capital lies on the Danube? — Budapest; Prague is on the Vltava, Warsaw on the Vistula, Bucharest on the Dâmbovița.

text: Nor da Egiptoko jainko txakal-buruduna, hildakoen zaindaria?
gloss: Who is the jackal-headed Egyptian god, guardian of the dead? — Anubis; Horus has a falcon's head.

text: Zein erlijio-ordena sortu zuen Loiolako Inazio azpeitiarrak?
gloss: Which religious order did Ignatius of Loyola, from Azpeitia, found? — The Jesuits (Society of Jesus, 1540).

text: Ur-botila beterik izozkailuan ahaztuz gero, lehertu egin daiteke. Zergatik?
gloss: A full water bottle forgotten in the freezer can burst. Why? — Water expands when it freezes.

text: Nork idatzi zuen «Bilbao-New York-Bilbao» eleberria?
gloss: Who wrote the novel "Bilbao-New York-Bilbao"? — Kirmen Uribe (2008, Spanish National Prize for Literature 2009).

text: Zein herrialdetan dago Angkor Wat tenplu-multzoa?
gloss: In which country is the Angkor Wat temple complex? — Cambodia; it is on the Cambodian flag.

text: Zein biolinista iruindarrek konposatu zuen «Zigeunerweisen»?
gloss: Which violinist from Pamplona composed «Zigeunerweisen»? — Pablo Sarasate (1878); Guridi was from Vitoria, Arriaga from Bilbao, Usandizaga from Donostia.

text: Zein arkitektok diseinatu zuen Donostiako Kursaal jauregia, itsasertzeko bi kubo handiak?
gloss: Which architect designed Donostia's Kursaal, the two large cubes by the sea? — Rafael Moneo (1999); Calatrava, Gehry and Foster built in Bilbao.

text: Euskal Herriko hiri hauetatik, zein dago iparralderen?
gloss: Of these Basque towns, which lies furthest north? — Bayonne (about 43.49° N), ahead of Donostia (43.32°), Bilbao (43.26°) and Mauléon (43.22°); the coast curves north into Lapurdi.

text: Gabriel Arestiren «Harri eta herri» poema-liburuak euskal poesia berritu zuen. Zein urtetan argitaratu zen?
gloss: Gabriel Aresti's "Harri eta herri" renewed Basque poetry. In which year was it published? — 1964.
